notes.subject: מותי
notes.rationale: Plural 'deaths' — Hebrew intensifies; rendered as single dai in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: מותי תמות
notes.rationale: Root repetition of מות (die/death) — 'the deaths of… you will die' — flattened in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: ערלים
notes.rationale: 'Uncircumcised' as shameful death; rendered descriptively since Tok Pisin lacks the technical term.

translation: Bai yu dai olsem ol man i no katim skin bilong en, long han bilong ol man bilong narapela ples, bikos mi tok olgeta, tok bilong Adonai Yahwe.
